posts.hook: North Korea is behind the biggest crypto heist of the year, and Anthropic's books just went public
posts.caption: the fbi blames north korea's tradertraitor group for the $6b binance hack, binance plans to reopen withdrawals in phases, anthropic's s-1 is being read line by line. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The FBI pins the $6B+ Binance hack on North Korea's TraderTraitor group
slides.desc: Same group it blamed for Bybit. Binance has covered ==95%== and restarts withdrawals in phases.

slides.title: Anthropic's S-1 is out, and the AI-bubble debate is reading it
slides.desc: Charts of the filing land beside warnings of cracks in the AI spending boom.

slides.title: A chained iframe bug let a share link read a ChatGPT user's private data
slides.desc: OpenAI fixed it and paid a $5,000 bounty, which looks cheap for the severity.

slides.title: Chatbots lean on three obscure AI-built sites for midterm voter answers
slides.desc: Copilot cited the error-prone Ballot Brief in 75% of tests, ChatGPT in 22%.

slides.title: DeepSeek open-sources a proactive coding agent to chase Claude Code
slides.desc: Super-Agent is a research prototype that can watch group chats for coding issues.

posts.hook: The AI boom now has a price tag in the credit market, and Google says space won't save it
posts.caption: bond investors are paying the most since 2021 to insure hyperscaler debt, google's data center energy chief says space data centers could cost up to 100x more than earth ones, russia-linked hacktivists keep causing physical damage in nato countries. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Insuring against hyperscaler debt defaults costs the most since 2021
slides.desc: Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle: investors are ==buying protection== on the AI bet.

slides.title: Google: space data centers could cost up to 100x more than Earth ones
slides.desc: Its energy head says US power is enough. Slow permits are the real bottleneck.

slides.title: Russia-linked hacktivists are causing physical damage in NATO countries
slides.desc: A crude two-year campaign, sometimes run by hackers who do not grasp what they hit.

terms.gloss: a hacker who attacks for political reasons

slides.title: Jepsen's author: LLMs make signs of a mature project easy to fake
slides.desc: If docs and polish can be counterfeited, ==proof of correctness== is what maintainers must show.

terms.gloss: a well-known test suite that probes databases for correctness bugs
